target.note: Labels are the iOS 26.4 Settings flow on a pt-BR simulator, live-verified on udid DBF8B093-58A2-4B57-812A-60D6CF8594BD. Data, not code. Environment facts driving the design: (1) argent `launch-app` returns status:init_failed here because the React-Native native-devtools dylib is not in the published package, so the harness foregrounds Settings via `xcrun simctl launch` (the iOS analog of the Android `am start` accommodation) and still measures the `launch-app` call for its token cost. (2) `simctl launch` restores Settings' last sub-screen (iOS state restoration), so the harness resets to the root by tapping the `BackButton` element until it is gone. (3) iOS taps are fire-and-forget (argent issue #547) so every navigation tap is verified by re-describe. (4) iOS 26 sim Settings exposes no shallow toggle switch and no describe-visible search field, so the Android 'toggle Battery Saver + assert state change' step is realized here as a 'navigate into a section + assert the new screen' transition — the interaction SHAPE (one agent action + one assert per step) that the token benchmark measures is preserved; the deviation is recorded in RESULTS.md/SUMMARY.md. Asserts use stable `com.apple.settings.*` / `BackButton` accessibility identifiers rather than localized text.
